# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 49 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** P.Mich. 130, Shepherd of Hermas 49 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_049_page_001.jpg

---

## Mandate 12, Part 6 — The Twelve Commandments and the Two Desires

**49:1** "These twelve commandments which I have given you, O Hermas, are to be kept and observed. But above all, keep faith. For if you keep faith, you shall keep all these things. And I will show you who are the ministers of these commandments so that you may know that I am not adding anything of my own here, but that these are truly commandments of God."

**49:2** "The twelve commandments are to be kept. When therefore the man who has faith in the Lord keeps these commandments, he will receive a great reward from the Lord, even life in the age to come. But the man who does not keep them shall die the death, because his works do not allow him to live."

**49:3** "All those who have the desire of evil shall remain in the wretched condition in which they are. But those who renounce evil desire and clothe themselves with the desire for good shall receive life from the Lord, because every good desire leads to life and every evil desire leads to death."

**49:4** "In addition, I say to you: guard the good desire and keep it, so that it may not depart from you. For it is strong and of great power. Keep it with all strength, for it will bring you life. But if you hold the evil desire, know that it will bring you to death, as I have already shown you."

**49:5** "The twelve commandments were given for the following reason, O Hermas: that you might learn that these commandments are from me, and that they are not the words of a man but of the Lord God. I have the authority to give such commandments. Keep them and you shall live."

---

*EMET renders the Greek of P.Mich. 130 with maximal literalness, preserving the culminating authority-claim that closes the Mandates section.*
